verdict.rationale: Consensus has a dedicated API page for integrating peer-reviewed citations into custom workflows and running automated searches. Its llms-full.txt states that a REST API and an MCP server expose the same retrieval and synthesis surface as the web app, so the core of programmatic access is evidenced. However, the pack shows only marketing-level descriptions, not the reference documentation itself. Missing for 10: API reference detail (endpoints, auth, rate limits), evidence the API is openly public rather than gated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
